name: Browse and Connectivity in VS Code for Fabric Warehouse
description: VS Code allows developers to explore Fabric Workspaces and connect directly to Fabric Warehouses, providing seamless access to data and objects. Key capabilities include:* Workspace exploration: Navigate Fabric Workspaces, including their warehouses, tables, views, and other artifacts.* Direct connectivity: Connect to one or multiple Fabric Warehouses from VS Code for querying or management.* Integrated workflow: Quickly access schemas and objects for development, debugging, or CI/CD without switching tools.

result.nameEs: Explorar y conectarse a Fabric Warehouse desde VS Code
result.descriptionEs: VS Code permitirá explorar workspaces de Fabric (warehouses, tablas, vistas y otros elementos), conectarse a uno o varios warehouses para consultar o administrar y acceder a esquemas y objetos para desarrollo, depuración o CI/CD sin cambiar de herramienta.
